chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who marries a virgin for pleasure (mut'ah), he said: 'It is disliked due to the defect (or stigma) upon her family.'

key_terms.مُتْعَةً: For pleasure (referring to Mut'ah or temporary marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a virgin in temporary marriage (mut'ah) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the dislike (karahah) of temporary marriage with a virgin is linked to the social consequence of 'ayb' (stigma or defect), reflecting the Shia juristic concern for preserving the virgin's dignity and family honor. This ruling highlights the distinction between the permissibility of mut'ah in principle and the recommended caution (istihbab) when marrying a virgin, ensuring the practice does not lead to social prejudice against her lineage.
